scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm run build --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.vercel-build: npm install --prefix server && cd server && npx prisma generate && cd .. && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
